events.verdict: Murphy III (NOP) initiates illegal contact with Wiggins' (GSW) arm during the steal attempt.
Green (GSW) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect Ingram's (NOP) pass away.
Payton (NOP) briefly brings his hand toward Curry's (GSW) path and marginal contact occurs as they come together on the perimeter.
Payton (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from Curry (GSW) as the steal occurs.
Wiggins (GSW) initiates contact with Murphy III's (NOP) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Boston Jr. (NOP) briefly grasps Wiggins' (GSW) jersey after he goes over the screen and the contact is marginal as it does not affect his ability to get to the pass.
Boston Jr. (NOP) grabs and pulls Wiggins' (GSW) jersey away from his body, which affects his shot attempt at the basket.
Moody (GSW) contests Murphy III's (NOP) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Wiggins (GSW) jumps forward and makes contact with Ingram's (NOP) body, which affects his SQBR at the start of the drive.
Boston Jr. (NOP) commits a take foul on Green (GSW).
Ingram (NOP) and Payton II (GSW) mutually engage and marginal contact occurs during their pursuit for the rebound.
Payton (NOP) establishes a screening position and marginal contact occurs as Green (GSW) switches on the pick.
Payton (NOP) and Curry (GSW) briefly engage and immediately disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs during the inbound.
Boston Jr. (NOP) commits a take foul on Hield (GSW).
Jemison (NOP) and Green (GSW) mutually engage and marginal contact occurs as they jostle for potential rebounding position before the free throw is scored.
Payton II (GSW) legally contests Murphy III's (NOP) jump shot attempt. Any foot contact is a result of Murphy III extending his right leg forward after releasing the shot attempt.
There is no clear or conclusive camera angle to determine if Boston Jr. (NOP) dislodges the ball from WIggins (GSW) to intentionally redirect it after the made basket.
Boston Jr. (NOP) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects the inbound pass away from Hield (GSW).
Hield (GSW) reaches for the ball and marginal contact occurs as he brushes Boston Jr.'s (NOP) arm before he starts his dribble in transition.
Hield (GSW) legally contests Murphy III's (NOP) jump shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Robinson-Earl (NOP) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Although Robinson-Earl initially makes contact with the ball, his hand slides off the ball and makes more than marginal contact with Green's (GSW) arm to dislodge it.
Payton (NOP) commits a take foul on Green (GSW).
